Not vendored: CodeGen/ (native code generation / JIT), Analysis/, Config/, Require/, Inliner/, CLI/, bench/, fuzz/, tests/, extern/, tools/ and every other file of the archive.
Built (see CMakeLists.txt): all .cpp of the retained directories except VM/src/linit.cpp, loslib.cpp, ldblib.cpp and lcorolib.cpp (the `os`, `debug` and `coroutine` libraries and luaL_openlibs).
No source file was modified: SHA256SUMS lists the digest of every retained file and tests/luau_build_test.py recomputes them. To update: replace the retained directories from the new archive, update this file and tests/luau_build_test.py's expected pin, and re-run the F06 suites.
Network: none at configure or build time; the sources are in the repository.
